listening.title: A progress meeting with the client

lines.speaker: Nam (Project Manager)
lines.text: Good morning, Ms. Hoa. Thank you for joining. Shall I walk you through this week's progress first?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Client Product Owner)
lines.text: Yes, please. I mainly want to know if the first deliverable is still on time.

lines.speaker: Nam (Project Manager)
lines.text: It is. The first progress update and demo will be ready next Wednesday morning.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Client Product Owner)
lines.text: That is good news. One of our managers raised a concern about the search speed.

lines.speaker: Nam (Project Manager)
lines.text: We noticed that too. The main constraint is the old database, which we cannot change.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Client Product Owner)
lines.text: I understand. Can your team still make the search faster in some way?

lines.speaker: Nam (Project Manager)
lines.text: Yes, we can add a cache layer. It needs about three extra days of work.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Client Product Owner)
lines.text: Three days is acceptable. Is that inside our current scope of work?

lines.speaker: Nam (Project Manager)
lines.text: It is a small addition, so we will cover it without extra cost this time.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Client Product Owner)
lines.text: Thank you. Let us align on the demo agenda and confirm the go-live date by email.
